No descriptive references listed; classification from Foley 2018; endangerment from Campbell et al. 2022 citing Z'graggen 1971.

sources.citation: Usher, Timothy. n.d. [accessed 2026-09-21]. South Ramu River. In T. Usher & E. Suter (eds), New Guinea World (Univ. of Zurich). Family page (Z'graggen's Annaberg group: Rao, Aram/Anor, Aren/Aiome) with proto-South Ramu reconstruction; Aiome reflexes from Z'graggen (1972), Anaberg and Atemble columns from Capell (1951-52).
sources.note: no statement; the 12 IPA stress marks on the page sit in Capell's Anaberg (Rao) and Atemble (Aram) columns (e.g. gəˈra 'sun', ˈakum 'blood'), none in the Aiome column (Z'graggen 1972 data, which omit stress); the only prosody-adjacent prose is about Rao first-syllable reduction (line 611)

sources.citation: Brooks, Joseph D. 2018. Realis and irrealis: Chini verb morphology, clause chaining, and discourse. PhD dissertation, University of California, Santa Barbara (ch. 2.5 'Chini and the Ramu family', pp. 69-87, surveys all Ramu languages and their documentation).
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: a digital copy exists, behind a library sign-in
sources.note: documentation note 'a few transcribed audio recordings for Aren, Aram, and Rao (Daniels 2015)' (p. 72) and a look-alike percentage (p. 76); no phonology

sources.citation: Anderson, Gregory D. S., Jason Yonai & K. David Harrison. 2015. Aren (Aiome) Talking Dictionary. Version 8.2015 (99 entries with audio; speaker Jason Yonai; recorded PNG Unitech, 27 Aug 2015). Living Tongues Institute for Endangered Languages / Swarthmore College.
sources.note: No prose at all: 99 headwords with practical spelling, phonetic transcription, gloss, Tok Pisin gloss and audio. A few transcriptions carry acute/grave/circumflex diacritics ([àgû] 'say', [à(ɣ)wiŋ] 'head', [àk’mɛ] 'stone', [awôŋ], [zʌ́ʌ̀] 'name') that look like impressionistic pitch/stress marks, but nothing defines them; wordlist-only data, not a statement. Audio (99 mp3 files) could support an instrumental check later.
sources.venue: Version 8.2015 (99 entries with audio; speaker Jason Yonai; recorded PNG Unitech, 27 Aug 2015)
